hypothesis: Doubling steps without other levers only raises cost and does not improve unit decode latency.
conclusion: The steps arm nearly halved latency on both smoke and held_out (19694.76ms -> 10244.61ms smoke p50; 19385.1ms -> 10256.33ms held_out p50) and raised smoke structural_similarity (0.417 -> 0.51), but the locked primary endpoint (held_out.structural_similarity) moved the wrong way (0.38248 -> 0.37006, -0.0124), below the 0.01 minimum-effect threshold in the losing direction. SDLC Phase A correctly rejects this as non-positive on the locked held-out primary despite the attractive smoke-only numbers -- a reminder that smoke deltas are not a substitute for the preregistered held-out endpoint.
next_priorities: Do not promote the steps-only variant; held_out primary regressed
Investigate whether the smoke-suite improvement (mpr, structural_similarity) is fixture overfitting given n=3 per suite
Re-run with a larger held-out fixture before drawing conclusions about the steps lever
